description: UMW TP4056 — single-cell Li-Ion/LiPo linear charger, 1A max charge current (resistor-programmable), 4.2V float. ESOP-8 package. Charge status output. Standard hobby LiPo charger IC.
name: tp4056
watch_out_for: ESOP-8 thermal pad MUST be soldered to a copper pour for rated current (derates hard uncovered). Rprog = 1200 / I_charge_mA (kOhm). No cell protection inside: pair with a DW01-class IC + FET.
